newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JUNE 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JUNE 18.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- European partners fail to reach agreement on European Union constitutional reform. French Socialists and Communists call for concrete measures for employment.

-- Government is seen as not having enough time to prepare a mini-budget for July, an early parliamentary session may be called in September to approve possible decrees issued by the government during the summer.
-- Thomson SA seeks to postpone its shareholders meeting to July 31, partly due to heavier-than-expected losses by its multimedia subsidiary Thomson Multimedia (TMM).
-- Unions seek to block plans by Dassault Aviation management to raise shareholder dividend by 270 percent for 1996.
-- LVMH buys 0.23 percent stake in GrandMet in bid to block planned merger with Guinness .
-- Ugine to pull out of stainless steel plant project in China.
-- Merger between Suez and Lyonnaise des Eaux to be formalised tomorrow, expected to boost activity. -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 42 21 53 81
